title: Souper-Model: How Simple Arithmetic Unlocks State-of-the-Art LLM Performance
abstract: arXiv:2511.13254v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have displayed remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, but their training remains resource- and time-intensive, requiring massive computational resources and careful orchestration of training procedures. Model souping-the practice of averaging weights from multiple models of the same architecture-has emerged as a promising pre- and post-training technique that can enhance performance without expensive retraining. We observe that previous souping approaches can lead to collapse in precision-sensitive LLM capabilities. In this paper, we introduce SoCE, a principled approach for model souping to overcome this shortcoming. The proposed method utilizes benchmark composition to identify optimal model candidates and applies non-uniform weighted averaging to maximize performance. translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.13254v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）在众多领域展现出了卓越的能力，但其训练仍然需要大量资源和时间，需要庞大的计算资源以及对训练过程的精心编排。模型汤——即对多个相同架构的模型权重进行平均的做法——已成为一种有前景的训练前和训练后技术，能够在无需昂贵重训练的情况下提升性能。我们观察到，以往的模型汤方法可能导致对精度敏感的LLM能力出现崩溃。在本文中，我们提出了SoCE，一种有原则的模型汤方法，以克服这一缺陷。所提出的方法利用基准测试组合来识别最优的模型候选者，并应用非均匀加权平均来最大化性能。与以往的方法相反，我们的方法利用了这样一个观察结果：……内部的不同簇（或类别的点……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SoCE方法，通过基准测试组合筛选最优模型候选并进行非均匀加权平均，克服了传统模型汤方法导致精度敏感能力崩溃的问题，从而仅用简单的权重算术运算即可解锁最先进的LLM性能。
